Name: Yes We're Dating--Abigail
Author: kettuluv
Description:
[size=3]Are you tired of your girlfriend/boyfriend's dialogue after you start dating defaulting to the normal dialogue, or the dating dialogue you do see not really being up to par?

Well, this mod aims to help with that!

With this mod, during seasons [color=#00ff00]Winter[/color][color=#ff0000] through [/color][color=#00ff00]Summer[/color], you will see dating dialogue from [color=#b4a7d6]Abigail[/color]. I've determined you'd probably hit 8 hearts around Winter, which is why I've started dialogue during Winter! (if requested, I might add dialogue for Fall too for a year long dating experience--let me know!)

By [color=#00ff00]default[/color], Abigail will acknowledge [color=#00ff00]if your player's gender is the same as hers[/color], therefore if you play as a [color=#00ff00]female farmer[/color], she will mention it in her dialogue. If you'd prefer to have her [color=#00ff00]not mention[/color] your farmer's gender, you can turn this off via Generic Mod Config Menu.

You will see [color=#00ff00]65+[/color] new lines of dialogue, including:
-3 [u]random[/u] variations of [color=#00ffff]8 heart[/color] dialogue for [color=#ff0000]each day of the week[/color] in [color=#00ff00]Winter[/color]
-3 [u]random[/u] variations of [color=#00ffff]10 hear[/color]t dialogue for [color=#ff0000]each day of the week[/color] in [color=#00ff00]Spring[/color]
-3 [u]random[/u] variations of [color=#00ffff]10 heart[/color] dialogue for [color=#ff0000]each day of the week[/color] in [color=#00ff00]Summer[/color]
-3 [u]random[/u] variations of [color=#00ffff]Rainy[/color] dialogue
-and some proposal dialogue!

I have plans to release a mod for each Bachelor/ette, and possibly release one big multipack mod when they're all done, but Abigail is just the first up to be complete! Please enjoy, and let me know if there's anything that needs fixing or any suggestions you may have. Thank you![/size]
